enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the Snyk vulnerability analyzer should be enabled.

aliasSyncEnabled.title: Alias Synchronization Enabled
aliasSyncEnabled.description: Whether to include alias information in vulnerability data.

checksumMatchingEnabled.title: Checksum Matching Enabled
checksumMatchingEnabled.description: Whether to send the `checksum` PURL qualifier to Snyk, so Snyk matches on the artifact checksum in addition to name and version. Only affects Maven components. Only the Snyk CLI populates this qualifier, via `snyk sbom --include-provenance`, so this has no effect for BOMs generated by other tools.

batchRequestsEnabled.title: Batch Requests Enabled
batchRequestsEnabled.description: Whether to request issues for multiple packages at once. The batch endpoint is not available to all Snyk organizations; disable this to request issues one package at a time instead.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of Snyk's REST API.

orgId.title: Organization ID
orgId.description: Organization ID to authenticate with the Snyk REST API.

apiToken.title: API Token
apiToken.description: API token to authenticate with the Snyk REST API.
